title: SessionManifest v1
description: Context for one exported capture session and the only authoritative location for session-wide capture and backend metadata. Structure only: sequencing, count identities, media pairing, and cross-artifact consistency are validated by the Python reference validator. Unknown optional properties are tolerated so the contract can evolve within major version 1.

session_manifest_schema_version.description: Semantic version of this artifact, independent of application, harness, model, and analysis versions.

session_id.description: Identifier joining this manifest to exactly one raw frame stream and its annotations.

participant_pseudonym_id.description: Pseudonymous participant identifier. The identity mapping is never stored in this repository.

capture_protocol_version.description: Version of the capture protocol the session was recorded under.

harness_git_sha.description: Full Git commit SHA-1 of the harness build that produced the session.

thermal_api_available.description: Whether the platform exposes a thermal state or headroom API on this device.

pose_pipeline.description: Backend, model, delegate, and topology metadata, recorded once per session rather than on every frame.

model_asset_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model asset file, pinning cross-platform comparability.

delegate.description: Backend execution delegate as reported by the platform. Left open because delegate names are platform vocabulary, not a contract decision.

min_pose_detection_confidence.description: Configured backend value, preserved as a number and never converted into an interpreted state.

landmark_topology.description: Name of the declared landmark topology. Deliberately not an enumeration: an unrecognized topology is reported by the semantic validator rather than being misvalidated against a fixed cardinality.

orientation_degrees.description: Clockwise rotation applied to reach the upright canonical plane.

model_input.description: Canonical model-input plane, distinct from the camera capture resolution.

live_preprocessing_contract_version.description: Version of the live camera-to-model-input preprocessing contract the harness implemented.

fixture_preprocessing_contract_version.description: Version of the decoded-frame fixture preprocessing contract, present only when the session replayed a fixture.

inference_drain_timeout_ms.description: Shutdown drain budget. A call still incomplete after this budget becomes a session_teardown_timeout entry in machine_inference_failures.

cadence.description: Configured, achieved, and tracker cadences kept as three distinct observations. Achieved cadence is a time series because a mean hides thermal throttling.

tracker_update_cadence_hz.description: Backend tracker update cadence when the backend exposes it, otherwise null.

clock.description: One monotonic time base per session. Wall-clock values are context only and are never used to order frames.

available_observations.description: Which coordinate families the backend supplied for this session. Reconciled against every frame by the semantic validator.

media_references.description: Media and fixture artifacts associated with the session. The bytes themselves are never committed.

counts.description: Capture-path counts. Their exact identities are reconciled by the semantic validator, not here.

camera_frames_received.description: Buffers delivered by the camera source.

inference_frames_submitted.description: Buffers submitted to the pose backend.

inference_records_emitted.description: NDJSON records written after completed backend calls.

frames_skipped_before_inference.description: Received frames never submitted to inference.

trailing_frames_skipped_after_last_emitt.description: Skipped frames not attributable to a later emitted record at session end, or every skipped frame when no record was emitted.

inference_failures.description: Submitted calls that failed before a RawPoseFrame could be emitted.

machine_inference_failures.description: Structured machine failures, separate from the human capture-quality failure log. These classifications are runtime observations and are never validator error codes.

capture_quality_observed.description: Human-checked setup observations. Observations only: no capture-quality engine, score, or threshold exists in Phase 0.

setup_failure_log.description: Free-text record of setup problems observed by the operator.

study_context.description: Extensible study-design labels such as angle, distance, camera height, environment, lighting, and clothing. Deliberately open so protocol labels stay versioned with the study rather than becoming rigid runtime fields.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Context only; never used for frame ordering.

cadence_sample.description: One achieved-cadence observation on the session monotonic time base.

media_reference.description: One media or fixture artifact. Cross-device synchronization records both an offset and a drift estimate, because monotonic clocks are device-local.

path_ref.description: Reference to the artifact in the access-controlled store. The bytes never enter this repository.

sync_offset_ns.description: Estimated offset between this media time base and the session monotonic time base.

sync_drift_ns_per_s.description: Estimated drift of that offset. Required alongside an offset; the pairing rule is enforced by the semantic validator.

classification.description: Stable harness classification. Runtime failure classifications live in this namespace and never masquerade as validator error codes.

source_error_code.description: Opaque source or backend code, retained verbatim for diagnosis.

detail.description: Sanitized detail. Never contains participant information.
